verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a 'Unified Payments API' letting merchants connect to 'all payment methods through a single API integration,' plus Hosted Payment Page, Payment Links, and Mobile SDK for broad channel coverage, and separately documents Google Pay acceptance via Google's UCP. However, the evidence pack never explicitly enumerates Apple Pay, bank redirects, or BNPL as supported methods within this unified integration. missing for 10: explicit documentation naming Apple Pay, bank redirect methods (e.g., iDEAL, Sofort), and BNPL providers as available through the single integration, plus independent/hands-on confirmation of wallet and BNPL checkout flows.
